title: Echo Cultural Fest 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 360 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 67,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
